breakdown.description: For K_Ic = 40 MPa√m and σ_y = 900 MPa, the plane-strain thickness criterion is about 4.9 mm, so B = 3 mm does not satisfy it.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth prompt specifies B = 6 mm (not 3 mm), which does satisfy the ~4.94 mm criterion. The generated specification correctly computes that the criterion requires ~4.94 mm and concludes B = 3 mm does NOT meet it — which is mathematically correct for B = 3 mm. However, the ground truth changes B to 6 mm so that the criterion IS satisfied (6 mm > 4.94 mm). The agent retained the incorrect B = 3 mm value from the incomplete prompt instead of using the corrected B = 6 mm from the ground truth, and thus reached the opposite conclusion from what the ground truth intends.
